messages:
deploybot: Hotfix request: routing-proxy image rp-hotfix-2026-04-02 to address 502 spikes on weight-based routing path in eu-west1. Canary showed fail rate jump to ~12% on certain tenant traffic. Request expedited approval to push to eu-west1. Link: https://dash.redwood.internal/alerts/9907

rob: summary of fix and risk? is this config or code? any chance of cross-region config leak?

deploybot: Fix: guard on route table iteration to avoid stale pointer when weight updates overlap (PR #6012). Code-only, no config drift. Deployment scoped to eu-west1; no cross-region changes.

lina: oncall here. Canary failed at 10% traffic. Need explicit rollback plan, owner, and auto-abort thresholds. I'm +1 after that.

oncall-bot: lina is oncall for routing today (rot: lina-eu). Auto-abort rule configured: abort stage if 502/503 > 6% for 4m OR downstream queue growth > 2x for 5m. Manual rollback cmd: `releasebot rollback routing-proxy v4.8.1 --region eu-west1`.

jyoti: product ack. This is impacting SLAs for a handful of customers; expedited approved if ops + oncall sign off.

chris: infra review: change looks isolated. I'm +1 but request a short staged rollout: 20% -> 60% -> 100% with 2m checks. Given severity, allow expedited but don't skip entirely. Who will run manual rollback?

rob: I'll own manual rollback if chris is busy. Add rollback snippet to relnotes and pin tag.

releasebot: Draft relnote: "routing-proxy: fix race in weight update iteration causing 502s under concurrent config updates. Backported to v4.8.2-rpfix. Pinned tag rp-hotfix-2026-04-02 -> v4.8.2-rpfix." Confirm to pin and proceed?

jyoti: relnote good. pin tag and attach incident link. cs-maya standby to prepare customer communication after successful deploy.

rob: approvals logged: chris (infra), jyoti (product), lina (oncall). Proceeding with expedited-staged rollout: stages 20,60,100 check 120s.

deploybot: CMD: `deploy --svc routing-proxy --img rp-hotfix-2026-04-02 --strategy expedited-staged --region eu-west1 --stages 20,60,100 --check 120s`

deploybot: stage 20% -> success. Monitoring 120s window.

lina: small blip to 3% 502s, okay. continuing.

deploybot: stage 60% -> success. Monitoring 120s.

chris: observing error rate trending down. Good sign.

deploybot: stage 100% -> success. No abort. Metrics: 502s dropped from 12% peak to 0.5% baseline.

cs-maya: prepping customer notes. Will send update with timeline and relnote link.

releasebot: Rollout complete. Release ticket closed and v4.8.2-rpfix pinned in release-logs/2026-04-02-routing. Follow-up: add short RCA to relnotes and monitor for 1 hour.
